Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

Our scope requires us to blend research and development with continuous delivery. The team is a mix of data scientists, algorithms engineers, software engineers, and AI infrastructure engineers, organized into two complementary groups. Research and development proves and matures new control, estimation, and forecasting capabilities and builds the evidence to decide what moves into the product. Continuous delivery turns that validated theory into reliable, deployable software and keeps it performing in the field.  
  
**The role**  
The Director, Power Applications leads this team and owns its outcomes on both workflows, reporting to the VP of AI and Applications.  
  
The job sits at the interface between research and implementation. description: Requisition ID # 175444 Job Category: Project / Program Management Job Level: Individual Contributor Business Unit: Energy Delivery Work Type: Hybrid Job Location: Oakland Department Overview The LEAPS Work Readiness Team coordinates with LEAPS counterparts and Line of Business (LOB) stakeholders to facilitate the delivery of work. The team serves as an intermediary between the LEAPS organization and LOB partners, aiming to ensure that tasks are completed appropriately and on schedule. Position Summary The Sr. Program Manager supports the LEAPS Work Readiness Team. The ideal candidate is open to a feedback culture, curious, eager to learn and teach others, and able to engage effectively with key stakeholders and influence others. This individual will be responsible for working with the Land, Environmental, and Enterprise Public Works teams as well as LOB partners. This role solves unique and complex program and process problems, anticipating issues and developing innovative process solutions in a collaborative manner to support LEAPS Work Readiness Program objectives, and may drive or support major cross-functional initiatives/improvement efforts. This role will require strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and Excel skills to be successful. The Sr. Program Manager may develop highly complex process tracking systems that have a wide range of impacts and applications across multiple departments related to PG&E interactions. This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business needs or company requirements. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory and will be agreed upon by the successful candidate and hiring leader. PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position.
